 Two product recalls announced November 5 warn consumers about a serious magnet-ingestion risk for children and a burn hazard involving baby-bottle sterilizer dryers.
 Magnetopia is recalling about 7,600 Magnetic Building Cubes and Blocks sets. Magnets can come loose if the cubes break or open. If swallowed, powerful magnets can attract each other inside the body and cause severe internal injuries or death.
 The sets were sold online at Magnetopia.com from April 2025 through October 2026 for $20 to $40. They came in 60-, 100-, 150- and 200-piece versions. The recall covers multiple models; the model number is printed on the back of the packaging. Consumers should stop using the cubes and contact Magnetopia for a full refund. The company will provide a prepaid label to return them. No incidents or injuries have been reported.

 Baby Brezza Enterprises is recalling about 29,000 SuperFast Sterilizer Dryers because they can overheat while plugged in and operating, creating a burn hazard. The recall covers models BRZ0083, BRZ0154 and BRZ0156; the model number is on the label on the bottom of the unit. The company has received 32 reports of overheating or melting plastic housing, with no injuries reported.
 The dryers were sold at TJ Maxx and Marshall’s stores nationwide and online at BabyBrezza.com, Target.com and Babylist.com from January 2024 through October 2026 for $160 to $180. Consumers should stop using the product and contact Baby Brezza for a free replacement, including shipping. Owners must complete the recall form and follow the company’s instructions to destroy and document the recalled unit.
